mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account ( user_id, financial_institution_id, ex_account_id, account_type, account_name, account_number, account_number_hash, masked_account_number, balance, account_status, opened_at, maturity_at, interest_rate, monthly_payment_limit ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{financialInstitutionId}, #{exAccountId}, #{accountType}, #{accountName}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountNumberHash}, #{maskedAccountNumber}, #{balance}, #{accountStatus}, #{openedAt}, #{maturityAt}, #{interestRate}, #{monthlyPaymentLimit} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_name = VALUES(account_name), balance = VALUES(balance), account_status = VALUES(account_status), maturity_at = VALUES(maturity_at), interest_rate = VALUES(interest_rate), monthly_payment_limit = VALUES(monthly_payment_limit), synced_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT account_id, user_id, financial_institution_id, ex_account_id, account_type, account_name, account_number, account_number_hash, masked_account_number, balance, account_status, opened_at, maturity_at, interest_rate, monthly_payment_limit FROM account WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.account_type AS accountType, a.account_name AS accountName, fi.financial_institution_name AS institutionName, a.masked_account_number AS maskedAccountNumber, a.balance - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(mb.balance) FROM money_box mb WHERE mb.account_id = a.account_id), 0) AS balance, a.account_status AS accountStatus, a.opened_at AS openedAt, a.maturity_at AS maturityAt, a.interest_rate AS interestRate, a.monthly_payment_limit AS monthlyPaymentLimit FROM account a INNER JOIN financial_institution fi ON a.financial_institution_id = fi.financial_institution_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.account_type AS accountType, a.account_name AS accountName, fi.financial_institution_name AS institutionName, a.masked_account_number AS maskedAccountNumber, a.balance - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(mb.balance) FROM money_box mb WHERE mb.account_id = a.account_id), 0) AS balance, a.account_status AS accountStatus, a.opened_at AS openedAt, a.maturity_at AS maturityAt, a.interest_rate AS interestRate, a.monthly_payment_limit AS monthlyPaymentLimit FROM account a INNER JOIN financial_institution fi ON a.financial_institution_id = fi.financial_institution_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} AND a.user_id = #{userId}
